text: Will work fine.. I have two 20" wreaths that I am going to store together in this bag.  I think they would store a much larger wreath by itself. It's thin, but I think it will work.  Once bagged, they just sit on a shelf in my storage area.  The others I have are hard sided. But honestly I think these will be fine.  I will update if there is an issue.
